Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Willie Green?

Willie Green is 45 years old.

Where was Willie Green born?

Willie Green was born in Detroit, Michigan.

When was Willie Green born?

Willie Green was born on July 28, 1981.

How tall is Willie Green?

Willie Green is 6-4 (193 cm) tall.

How much did Willie Green weigh when playing?

Willie Green weighed 200 lbs (90 kg) when playing.

Is Willie Green in the Hall of Fame?

Willie Green is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Willie Green drafted?

Willie Green was drafted by Seattle SuperSonics, 2nd round (12th pick, 41st overall), 2003 NBA Draft.

What position did Willie Green play?

Shooting Guard.

When did Willie Green retire?

Willie Green last played in 2015.

What is Willie Green's net worth?

Willie Green made at least $23,473,246 playing professional basketball.

How much did Willie Green make?

Willie Green made $3,976,000 in 2011.

What did Willie Green average?

Willie Green averaged 8.3 points, 1.8 rebounds, and 1.4 assists per game.

How many rings does Willie Green have?

Willie Green won 0 championships.

What schools did Willie Green attend?

Willie Green attended Cooley in Detroit, Michigan and Detroit Mercy.
